name: DeepTutor
one_liner: An AI tutor that remembers a student over time and adapts lessons to them personally, instead of resetting to zero every session like a normal chatbot.
buyer: An ed-tech startup or homeschool parent who wants personalized, continuously-adapting tutoring without hiring a full-time 1:1 human tutor.
business_use_cases: An ed-tech startup white-labels it as the tutoring engine behind a subject-specific app, like math or language learning.
A homeschooling parent runs it locally to give their child a tutor that remembers weak spots across months, not just one session.
A test-prep company builds a product on top that tracks a student's long-term progress toward a target SAT or GRE score.

money_ideas.idea: A per-student monthly subscription for a hosted tutoring product built on this engine.
Licensing the engine to existing ed-tech platforms as a backend upgrade.

steal_this: Pick one narrow subject, like high-school algebra, and launch a $15/month 'personal AI tutor' product this weekend using this as the backend.
